title: Nature of the EWS-FLI1 Oncoprotein.
authors: Kress, James W; Eles, Henriette; Bosley, James
journal: The journal of physical chemistry. B
one_liner_zh: 该文用MD和DFT分析EWS-FLI1癌蛋白的反应性，虽涉及蛋白-DNA互作相关体系但未聚焦TF-DNA结合机制，方法可迁移但深度有限。
abstract: The research presented in this paper focuses on the EWS-FLI1 oncoprotein, a critical factor in Ewing sarcoma, a rare and lethal cancer primarily affecting children and young adults. Through molecular dynamics and quantum mechanics analyses, the study explores the reactivity properties of six snapshots of the EWS-FLI1 oncoprotein, aiming to contribute to the development of targeted therapies. The investigation emphasizes the significance of understanding the molecular behavior of EWS-FLI1 for effective treatment development, utilizing computational methods such as density functional theory. The findings suggest that EWS-FLI1 is a compact, electrophilic protein with localized reactive sites, providing valuable insights for potential drug development and enhancing our knowledge of Ewing sarcoma for targeted treatments.
abstract_zh: 本文所呈现的研究聚焦于EWS-FLI1癌蛋白，这是尤文肉瘤（一种主要影响儿童和青少年的罕见致命癌症）中的关键因子。通过分子动力学 (molecular dynamics) 和量子力学分析，该研究探讨了EWS-FLI1癌蛋白六个快照的反应性特性，旨在为靶向疗法的开发做出贡献。研究强调了理解EWS-FLI1分子行为对于有效治疗开发的重要性，并利用密度泛函理论 (density functional theory) 等计算方法。研究结果表明，EWS-FLI1是一种紧凑的、亲电性的蛋白质，具有局部反应位点，为潜在药物开发提供了宝贵见解，并增强了我们对尤文肉瘤靶向治疗的认识。
